name: simplify-med
description: Helps patients around a medical visit: prepare for an appointment, simplify supplied clinical documents into a short plain-language report checked against the source, and take a brief personal health-literacy screen. It works only from the text the patient supplies or their own health records they ask it to retrieve: it never searches the web or any outside source, and never reads or interprets medical images such as X-rays, scans, or ECG tracings.

interface.shortDescription: Turn medical paperwork into a fact-checked plain-language report.
interface.longDescription: Prep gets a patient ready for an appointment with stated requirements, a things-to-bring checklist, and prioritized questions. Simplify turns supplied clinical documents into a short plain-language report and checks every statement against the source in a separate verification pass. Med Lit runs a brief, opt-in health-literacy screen and returns a personal support profile. It works only from the text the patient supplies or their own health records they ask it to retrieve: it never searches the web or any outside source, and never reads or interprets medical images such as X-rays, scans, or ECG tracings.
defaultPrompt: Run the complete $simplify workflow on the supplied medical documents: write the short report, verify it against the source, and return only the verified report.
